name: Konnect Contact Form Builder
author: jmiel

sections.description:
Konnect Contact Form Builder is a simple yet powerful contact form plugin that allows you to create customizable contact forms for your WordPress website. Manage all form submissions from your WordPress admin panel.

Features

  • Customizable form fields (Name, Email, Phone, Address, Message)
  • Enable/disable individual fields
  • Make fields required or optional
  • Customize field labels and placeholders
  • View and manage all submissions in admin panel
  • Export email list to Excel
  • AJAX form submission (no page reload)
  • Responsive design
  • Elementor integration
  • Translation ready

Usage

After installation, you can:

  1. Use the shortcode [konnect-contact-form] anywhere on your site
  2. Add the form using the Elementor widget
  3. Customize form settings under “Contact Messages > Form Settings”
  4. View submissions under “Contact Messages > Messages”
  5. Export emails under “Contact Messages > Email List”

Support

For support, please visit https://jmiel.com or use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/konnect-contact-form-builder/ directory, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the shortcode [konnect-contact-form] or Elementor widget to add the form to your pages
  4. Configure settings under “Contact Messages > Form Settings”
sections.faq:
How do I add the contact form to my page?

You can add the form in two ways:
1. Use the shortcode [konnect-contact-form] in any post, page, or widget
2. Use the Elementor widget if you’re using Elementor page builder

Can I customize the form fields?

Yes! Go to “Contact Messages > Form Settings” to enable/disable fields, change labels, placeholders, and set which fields are required.

Where do the form submissions go?

All submissions are stored in your WordPress database and can be viewed under “Contact Messages > Messages” in your admin panel.

Can I export the email addresses?

Yes! Go to “Contact Messages > Email List” and click the “Export to Excel” button.

Is the form mobile-friendly?

Yes, the form is fully responsive and works great on all devices.
